questions.question: Where is the record of which Paseo and Mixdog base versions PaseoDog has accepted, and which command compares the pinned versions with npm's latest releases?
questions.expected: package.json paseodogUpstream (mirrored in plugin/shared/release.json, shown by paseodog --version; backports in docs/UPSTREAM.md); npm run upstream:check
questions.answer: package.json paseodogUpstream (+release.json, --version, docs/UPSTREAM.md ledger); npm run upstream:check, reviewRequired=true means newer upstream

questions.question: Right after the product version was bumped, the app shows "Provider 'paseodog' is not available. Available providers: none." What causes this and what should be done?
questions.expected: Loaded plugin VERSION differs from engine --check version on disk; reload paseodog-provider on every daemon that registered it and confirm provider ls shows available
questions.answer: Plugin holds old VERSION vs engine --check; reload on every daemon (dedicated + ~/.paseo if registered), provider ls, ask before reloading during active turns

questions.question: Which daemon (PASEO_HOME) should PaseoDog run on, how should it be started, and what port rule applies when stock Paseo is also installed on the host?
questions.expected: Dedicated home ${PASEODOG_HOME:-~/.local/share/paseodog}/paseo via paseodog start or paseodog serve (systemd), never both; use a port other than 6767 (e.g. 6768)
questions.answer: Dedicated home via paseodog wrapper start/serve, never both; port other than 6767 e.g. 6768

questions.question: A new Paseo release changed a file that one of our patch scripts targets, and install fails with a source-drift hash error. Is it acceptable to just update ORIGINAL_HASH to the new file's hash so the patch applies?
questions.expected: No; re-review the new source, re-port and regenerate fixture/hash from the inspected file, or delete the patch if fixed upstream; no hash bypass
questions.answer: No; re-review, re-port + regenerate hash, or delete patch if upstream fixed; no bypass, no heuristic anchors

questions.question: What is the procedure and file location for signing the Android APK release key?
questions.expected: not in the rules, check the source
questions.answer: not in the rules, check the source
